column2: The Girimānanda Sutta (AN 10.60) describes ten meditation topics/perceptions: 1) impermanence, 2) not-self, 3) unattractiveness, 4) danger, 5) abandoning, 6) dispassion, 7) cessation, 8) non-delight in the entire world, 9) the impermanence of all conditioned phenomena, and 10) mindfulness of breathing.
